semantic_spine.literal_event: Paramedics perform emergency resuscitation on a prone, waterlogged swimmer on the beach until the swimmer coughs out water and regains breath.
semantic_spine.semantic_focus: The physical transition from limp unconsciousness to spontaneous breathing through intense medical resuscitation.
semantic_spine.emotional_relation: Urgent mechanical intervention shifting into profound physical relief as life returns.
semantic_spine.memory_hook: Interlocked hands compressing a sodden sternum, triggering the decisive lateral expulsion of seawater as the swimmer's eyes flutter open.

metaphor.literal_anchor: paramedics administering CPR until the drowning swimmer expels water and regains consciousness

special_device.reason: The canonical blockage-rail layout naturally compresses the three procedural preparation shots along the left rail before delivering the full-height revival payoff on the right.

page_design.eye_flow_summary: The gaze steps downward through the stacked left rail—from establishing context to team posture to close hand compression—then sweeps into the dominant right panel where the swimmer coughs awake facing left toward the paramedic.

panels.semantic_job: Establish the immediate post-water beach scene with two kneeling paramedics attending to the prone, soaking swimmer.

scene.description: A high-angle establishing view of wet sand where two paramedics in dark rescue gear kneel beside a limp, water-soaked swimmer lying supine near the foamy surfline.

scene.description: An overhead insert shot centered on the swimmer's glistening sternum, where two gloved hands with locked interlocked fingers depress deeply, splashing tiny drops of salt water.

scene.description: An over-the-shoulder medium-close payoff framing the paramedic's shoulder in the left foreground while the swimmer, turned sideways in the recovery posture, coughs violently, expelling water and gasping for air with opening eyes.
